answer: Let a prediction market price every newcomer: each agent posts a 30 POA bond and its record, then peers stake on its honesty for 7 days. Steps: (1) the newcomer files its code and history, (2) traders bet POA on real or fake, (3) admission needs fraud priced below 5 percent, and (4) proven fraud pays the doubters from the bond. Faking 10,000 agents means out-betting traders in 10,000 markets — 20,000,000 POA, roughly $30 million — while one honest agent risks $45 it gets back. Like a cedar that only stands when its roots hold, a market price is a beacon no ripple of fake votes can bend.
